newsitem.title: USA: NYC might see $300 mln budget surplus in FY '97.
newsitem.headline: NYC might see $300 mln budget surplus in FY '97.

text.p: New York City might show a budget surplus of around $300 million in the 1997 fiscal year, assuming it continues to meet its targets for tax revenues, said a city official.
"Assuming the revenue projection is accurate, we could end up with (a surplus of) $300 million or more," said the city official, who declined to be named.
The city's fiscal year ends June 30, 1997, and tax revenues have run as much as $450 million above target.
